newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond holds 93.470 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond holds 93.470 support.

text.p: *Australian bond futures ended the pre-weekend SYCOM session little changed from Friday's pit levels with the 10-year bond holding above support at 93.470.
*Ten-year bond seen retaining a 93.470/93.570 range for now.
*U.S. yields creep higher ahead of this week's key data.
Australian bond futures ended the pre-weekend SYCOM session little changed from Friday's pit levels with the 10-year bond holding above support at 93.470.

Analysts said the contract needs to hold this level to maintain the steep one month rally from 92.825, and the broader advance from 91.700 in early April, to have another stab at last week's all time high of 93.640.

For now the 10-year bond is seen holding a 93.470 to 93.570 range with the market unlikely to aggressively take fresh long positions at current lofty levels. But equally, hopes of a monetary policy easing are unlikely to see the market slip away.

Last week's subdued inflation and wages data re-enforced speculation of a 1/2 point cut in 5.5 percent official interest rates, and this week's reports for retail trade and building approvals are not expected to alter that view.

An easing has been more or less priced in for well over a month, although the general expectation now is that the market will have to wait for another 1-1/2 weeks before the Reserve Bank endorses the move, and after the August 5 board meeting.
However, traders will still keep a wary on the bank's daily market operations at 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) every day until then.
Meanwhile, U.S. bond yields crept higher on Friday during a tightly traded session ahead of this week's major U.S. data.
Of key importance will be Tuesday's second quarter employment cost index, the advance second quarter GDP on Thursday and the July non-farm payrolls report on Friday.
